name: redundant-harness-folders
goal: Remove redundant component namespaces, preserve helper placement, identities, routes and rendered behavior, and reject reintroduction

evidence: The existing component-category migration inserted a product namespace beneath explorer-ui and retained 84 internal forwarding files. Flatten 85 implementations; keep public route directories and registered IDs.

Existing registry/category checks required explorer-ui grouping and visual scenarios but allowed nested product-name directories. Extend the standard visual registry guard; pre-relocate test imports before freezing its genuine source-policy failure. Extend existing migration guard to retain original moves with explicit reviewed follow-up locations.
